summary: Re-review r2 of the T5r remediation (9440c572). The __proto__ finding is fixed: copy.ts now copies every own key via Object.defineProperty, and probes confirm own __proto__ keys survive as data, clone prototypes stay clean, Object.prototype and Array.prototype are untouched, sparse arrays keep length and holes, cycles still terminate, getters are read once per copy, and the depth/DoS profile is unchanged (deepCopy survives deeper than native structuredClone). The three-file gate is green with 13 tests, including new failing-first pins for the remediated items. Four earlier nonblocking findings (symbol keys, RegExp clones, non-enumerable properties, cross-realm flattening) are kept, all contract-out and unreachable in the pinned plain-data sim states.
nonblocking_findings: F2 kept | CONTEST kept: Symbol-keyed own properties are still silently dropped (probe R15); the spec contract (AC1 rule 3) covers own string keys only, and no pinned sim state uses symbol keys, so the divergence from structuredClone is documented but not remediated.

F3 kept | CONTEST kept: RegExp values still copy into objects that pass instanceof RegExp but throw TypeError on exec (src/apk3d/sim/copy.ts:68-73 generic branch); no sim state holds a RegExp per the T1 type pin, so the latent crash is unreachable today.

F4 kept | CONTEST kept: Non-enumerable own properties are still dropped (Object.keys at src/apk3d/sim/copy.ts:76 is enumerable-only); divergence from structuredClone, unreachable in the pinned plain-data sim states.

F5 kept | CONTEST kept: Cross-realm Map/Set/Date/Promise values still silently flatten to {} because the instanceof guards at src/apk3d/sim/copy.ts:26-51 fail across realms; single-realm codebase today.
